name: audio-channel-queue
description: Allows you to queue audio files to different playback channels.

scripts.prepack: npm run validate && npm run build
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.publish:patch: npm version patch && npm run publish:release
scripts.publish:minor: npm version minor && npm run publish:release
scripts.publish:major: npm version major && npm run publish:release
scripts.publish:release: npm run validate && npm run build && npm publish
scripts.publish:dry: npm run validate && npm run build && npm publish --dry-run

author: Tony Carpenter
